biotools.summary: CGeNArate is a sequence-dependent coarse-grained model for DNA molecular dynamics simulations, allowing for accurate atomistic resolution with reduced computational effort. The software enables simulations of very long segments of B-DNA for biotechnological and chromatin studies.
